Daily Devotional

September 27

10 Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom. (Proverbs 13:10 KJV)

Contention is the beginning of strife, and the Word tells us that where strife and envying are, there is every evil work by the devil (James 3:16). The Christian should be very careful to not ever get into contention or strife, as it will let the devil have unlimited access to you, and bring all kinds of problems into your life. Remember that the devil only comes to steal, kill and destroy (John 10:10).

Note that all contention and strife come from pride, and only by pride. Remember that pride is not just arrogance, but is any form of being self-centered, which can be thinking you are better than others, or being shy is another form of pride. Any time you are self-centered, or thinking only of yourself, then you are exhibiting pride. If you follow what Jesus taught of thinking more of others than you do of yourself, then you will stay away from pride. Notice that being well advised is wisdom, and wisdom and understanding are two attributes that the Word says we should seek after (Proverbs 4:7). I believe it is telling us that those that are always into strife are not too bright. Thank you Lord for your directions.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com

Hello, fellow shitlords. You may notice the links I post sometimes come from a site called archive.is. You probably don't care why that is, but I figured I'd tell you anyway.

What is this archiver thingy?

An archiver does several things that are positive for shitlord-tier internet forums. You copy-paste a link into the prompt and out comes a link that you can use.

Okay, but what does it do and why should I care?

It does 3 things for sites like this.

  1. Clickshekels. When you click on a link, those clicks are tracked and the site or author gets paid ad revenue. Due to the nature of what we discuss here, in most cases, we don't necessarily want Schlomo Goldstein to make money because we wanted to read his article. In a lot of cases, we are simply reading the article because we are making fun of the contents and the publication. It doesn't make much sense to pay their salary, does it? Of course not.

  2. Site referral. When you click a link from v/niggers, we don't need the admin of that site to know we are coming from a shitlord-tier forum. I think we can all agree that the New York Times or Washington Post doesn't need to know about v/niggers. We don't need this place crawling with journalists or other kikes from the media looking to do a story on us.

  3. Articles are edited and changed. How many times have you went to tell someone about a tweet or Facebook post only to see that the asshole cocksucker deleted it before you could tell anyone? How many times does an article change or get taken down because the publication changed its mind and decided it would be best if the truth about niggers is swept under the rug? All before you could share it with all of us, too. Well, using an archiver preserves the original content so that if it's deleted or changed, you still have the original copy of what was said. Archiving in this way even stands up in court, so it will always remain just the way you saw it.

Personally, I use http://www.archive.is but there are other ones. Archive.is just seems to be more no frills and other ones have taken down content before where no issues have been found with .is.

Just food for thought. You should use it. Sometimes a page has already been archived by a shitlord and the link is already available.
